name: 76109 · Fort Worth, TX
findings: ZIP 76109 (Fort Worth) has 141 nonprofit organizations. 59 of them (42%) list at least one way to get involved in their tax returns or on their websites: membership, volunteering, public events, or civic and political action.
The most common is membership, listed by 48 organizations.
Social and fraternal organizations are the largest group offering opportunities (26% of those with an identified type).
Compared with 10 similar places, ZIP 76109 (Fort Worth) has about as many organizations offering opportunities per resident.

observations.text: 14 foundation organizations here list none of the four kinds of opportunity in their tax returns or on their websites. Many may still offer them without describing them there.
